title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
content: You can cancel your StreamAssist subscription at any time. To cancel: 1) Log in and go to Account > Subscription. 2) Click 'Cancel Subscription'. 3) Follow the prompts to confirm. Access continues until the end of your current billing period. We do not offer prorated refunds for unused time. For billing errors or exceptional cases, contact our support team to request a refund review.
